scenes.title: MOSFET Basics
scenes.narration: A MOSFET is a three-terminal device with a gate, source, and drain. Its layout is defined by electrical requirements and specific technology design rules.

scenes.title: Device Layout
scenes.narration: To optimize performance, we use metal interconnects and minimize junction areas. The gate extends beyond the channel to ensure reliable definition of the transistor edge.

scenes.title: MOSFET as Capacitor
scenes.narration: Beyond switching, a MOSFET acts as a capacitor. Its capacitance changes based on gate voltage, shifting from depletion modes to a stable oxide capacitance.
